description: This is a shell script related to network configuration and QoS management, including functions for manipulating network interfaces, configuring traffic rules, and managing firewall rules within a Linux/OpenWRT environment.

methods.name: add_insmod
methods.description: Function to add kernel modules with insmod or modprobe, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: find_ifname
methods.description: Function to find network device interface name, depending on environment (OpenWRT or fallback).

methods.name: parse_matching_rule
methods.description: Parses network matching rules for QoS and firewall configuration based on specified options.

methods.name: config_cb
methods.description: Callback to handle specific configuration sections such as interface or classification rules.

methods.name: qos_parse_config
methods.description: Parses individual QoS configuration blocks from a config source.

methods.name: enum_classes
methods.description: Enumerates and assigns class numbers for a group of classes.

methods.name: cls_var
methods.description: Sets class variables like packet size, delay, rate, etc., based on configuration.

methods.name: tcrules
methods.description: Generate traffic control rules using awk script based on device and rate parameters.

methods.name: start_interface
methods.description: Initializes and configures a network interface with QoS rules and traffic shaping.

methods.name: start_interfaces
methods.description: Starts configuration for multiple network interfaces.

methods.name: add_rules
methods.description: Adds iptables rules based on specified rules and parameters.

methods.name: start_cg
methods.description: Sets up a QoS class group with associated firewall and traffic control rules.

methods.name: start_firewall
methods.description: Initializes firewall chains and rules for QoS enforcement.

methods.name: stop_firewall
methods.description: Removes QoS-related iptables rules and chains during shutdown or reconfiguration.
